## Complete 16 Practice Areas
1. Income Tax (Direct Taxation, Return Filing, 12A/80G, TDS, 15CA/15CB, Assessments)
2. Goods & Service Tax (GST Registrations, Filings, Refunds, Audits, DRC-01 Replies)
3. Corporate Advisory (Company Incorporation, Certifications, Internal Audits)
4. Partnerships & LLPs (Formation, Deed Drafting, Restructuring, Registrations)
5. Internal Control Design (SOPs, Risk Matrices, Operational Due Diligence)
6. Certifications (Turnover, Networth, Receivable, Statutory & RERA Certifications)
7. Startups & Registrations (DPIIT Startup India, Section 80-IAC, MSME/Udyam)
8. Accounting & Payroll (Full-cycle bookkeeping, Zoho/Tally/SAP, MIS, TDS/PF/ESI)
9. Financial Advisory & Virtual CFO (Working Capital, CMA Data, Debt Advisory)
10. International Taxation (Transfer Pricing, 3CEB, DTAA, 15CA/15CB)
11. ROC Compliances (AOC-4, MGT-7, Director KYC, Charge Creation)
12. Statutory Audits (Companies Act 2013 Audits, Tax Audits u/s 44AB, Trust Audits)
13. Business Valuation & Advisory (DCF Valuation, Rule 11UA, FEMA / FDI, ESOP Valuation)
14. FEMA & RBI Compliances (FC-GPR, SMF, Inbound/Outbound FDI, FLA Returns)
15. Trust & NGO Services (12AB, 80G, CSR-1, FCRA Compliances)
16. Indirect Tax Litigation (Appeals before GST Appellate Authority, SCN Replies)
